content: 1. What type of healthcare professional are you? Options: Physician, Registered Nurse, Advanced Practice Nurse, or Other (please specify). 2. What is your area of specialty? Options: Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Surgery, Urology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Radiology, Anesthesia, Family Medicine, or Ophthalmology. 3. What is your level of training? 4. What is your gender? Options: Male, Female, or Do not wish to disclose. Work Hours 5. How many hours do you work per week? 6. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past week (in hours)? 7. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past month (in hours)? 8. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past year (in hours)? Sleep Habits 9. How many hours do you currently sleep per day on average? 10. How many hours did you sleep per day before entering the medical profession? Brief Medical History 11. Do you take any medications that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Options: Yes or No. 12. Are you diagnosed with any medical illness that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Options: Yes or No. Driving History 13. How do you commute to and from work? Options: Drive (car or motorcycle), Public Transportation, Bicycle, Walk, or Other (please specify). 14. How long is your commute to and from work on average (each way)? 15. How many years have you held a driver’s license? Options: Less than 5 years, 5–10 years, 11–15 years, 16–20 years, or More than 20 years. 16. Have you ever been in an accident prior to entering the medical profession? 17. How many motor vehicle accidents have you ever been involved in? 18. How many of those accidents occurred due to falling asleep at the wheel? 19. How many accidents do you attribute to sleep deprivation? Motor Vehicle Accident History 20. Have you ever felt drowsy or fatigued after a work shift? Options: Yes or No. 21. Have you ever fallen asleep at the wheel after a shift? Options: Yes or No. 22. Have you ever had a near accident while driving after a shift? Options: Yes or No. 23. Have you ever had an accident while driving after a shift? Options: Yes or No. 24. Do you know any healthcare professionals who have had a motor vehicle accident after a shift? Questions for Those with Sleep Deprivation-Related Motor Vehicle Accidents 25. How long was your shift immediately prior to the accident? 26. Did you receive any government disability compensation due to this accident? Options: Yes or No. If yes, what was the estimated amount? 27. Did any persons involved in the accident receive government disability compensation as a result of the accident? Options: Yes or No. If yes, what was the estimated amount? 28. Did the accident cause any psychological disturbance to you or your family members?
